title: Repair-state PI v2 — consolidated trainable design
decision: One new training recipe after correctness validation; no sequential algorithm ablation campaign.

requirements: Before implementation, copy the complete original 1K baselineguard source with a full SHA manifest; do not exclude nested config/data source directories.
Use independent experiment identity, logs, trials, checkpoints and deployment path.
Verify the original source manifest remains unchanged after implementation.
Existing 1K/2K checkpoints, merged models, evidence and failed runs are not overwritten or deleted.

pi_definition.expression: P_t = deterministic summary of Delta(B,W_t), bounded local code context, completed Agent execution evidence E_<t, and known logical budgets; only captured before generation t.
pi_definition.baseline: Immutable prepared buggy source tree; no ancestor history or reference solution.
pi_definition.workspace: Actual current task worktree, including added/deleted files. Verified capture interval and consistency checks; not claimed atomic or full Markov state.
code_block: Compact baseline-to-current before/after hunks with exact source text and explicit old/current labels.
Deduplicate ranges; include relative path, enclosing symbol signature and necessary local context.
Bounded same-module imports and directly referenced local definitions/signatures; deterministic static traversal only, no semantic retriever or LLM.
Represent non-code/config changes and removals explicitly. Syntax parsing is a static observation, never a correctness verdict.
Changed/new/reverted units since the previous observation get first allocation; remaining current edits are allocated across files deterministically. Coverage and omission counts remain explicit.
execution_block: Most recent completed Agent command result and latest known already-executed test summary, parsed only from Agent-observed events.
Return code, completed/timeout/unknown status, and available logical call/token budget.
Evidence freshness: associate command evidence with observed workspace versions at execution boundaries; mark changed/stale or unknown when attribution is uncertain.
A prior passing test is not represented as a current-code passing test after a subsequent edit.
No result for a pending command and no future result backfilled into earlier PI.

event_capture.implementation: Journal exact completed tool messages at the live proxy boundary before generation. No SDK callback or Agent change.
event_capture.source_limit: Already Actor-visible tool observations only; no verifier or extra tests.
event_capture.freshness: Unknown at observation because execution-boundary workspace snapshots are unavailable; stale after observed workspace change.

excluded: Hidden evaluation tests or their identifiers
terminal verifier outputs as earlier PI
reference patches or injected bug locations

budget.truncation: Prefer complete hunk/line units; mark omitted ranges and exceptionally long-line truncation. Never present a truncated entity as complete.
budget.allocation: Chronological causal allocation only. Never reallocate earlier PI based on future trajectory length. Reserve a compact exhaustion marker; when exhausted, omit subsequent PI explicitly in audit rather than trimming Actor tokens or fabricating an empty workspace.

deduplication.code: Insert the current code capsule only on workspace/code-view change; do not resend it solely because budgets or command status changed.
deduplication.execution: A small status line is eligible at every generation, referencing the latest represented code state with a short local identifier.
deduplication.restore: Nonconsecutive return to an earlier workspace state must be represented explicitly.
deduplication.omitted_capsule: Never label an unrepresented new code state as an unchanged or fully visible state.

critic_input.layout: One trajectory per row; exact Actor token history with causally ordered PI blocks inserted immediately before each generated span.
critic_input.history: Historical PI remains visible causally. New code-state blocks explicitly supersede earlier current-state descriptions; current-only attention is not claimed.
critic_input.value_alignment: Read value immediately before each sampled Actor token using the audited gather mapping.
critic_input.loss_mask: Original sampled action positions only. PI/tool-observation tokens add no action loss positions or denominator weight.
critic_input.invariant: Value inference and Critic update share the same builder. Actor input IDs, logprobs, response mask, reward, SAO/GAE and update timing remain unchanged.
critic_input.archive: Persist exact proxy IDs/logprobs/masks, PI bytes/token segments, completed-observation references, full pre-update batch tensors (returns and filtered-row state), and config/source identity. Gather positions are reconstructed from these inputs with the versioned builder, not separately persisted.

learning.initialization: New independent fresh run from the existing Qwen3.5-9B base; no continuation from old PI Critic checkpoints.

critic_head.initialization: Unmodified SAO baseline model initialization; no zero weights or 0.5 bias override.

learning.critic_trainable: Exactly SAO baseline resolved named-parameter mask; no final-eight-layer unfreeze.
learning.critic_frozen: Baseline freeze patterns self_attn., linear_attn., visual.; unchanged implementation.
learning.value_objective: Existing clipped value MSE on valid action positions
learning.actor_gae: Preserve resolved original SAO length-adaptive GAE configuration
learning.training_data: Existing 6248-task training dataset, one epoch, 97 full-batch steps
learning.other_recipe: Full baseline Hydra command identical except experiment/output identity. Only PI environment and persistence options differ.

persistence.complete_marker: Publish only after all required shards and data state are saved and validated.
persistence.resume: Explicit complete checkpoint of this new experiment only; missing/corrupt checkpoint does not silently become a fresh run.
persistence.storage_note: Baseline parameter mask unchanged; retain 200GiB minimum and recheck free space before every save.
persistence.deletion: No automatic deletion of original or new assets.
persistence.limitation: Checkpoint5 cannot protect a failure before step5 completes; restart is not promised bitwise-equivalent across external service scheduling.

runtime_correctness: Preserve immutable baseline observer, whole-snapshot retry and session-closed handling.
Port and validate strict known SDK tool-call split mapping in the new copy; reject unknown rewrites.
Do not substitute old/empty PI on collection failure or invent historical logprobs.
Classify unresolved infrastructure rewards using the existing invalid-row rules.

only_required_validation: CPU causality, budgeting, state reversion, event freshness and Actor-token alignment regression
Real Harbor/SDK integration without extra task tests
Distributed finite-value/gradient smoke with unchanged baseline freeze mask (pending; no formal training).
Save/load with pre-first-update Actor optimizer and exact next-batch/global-step continuity check
validation_and_launch.full_training_resource: Original SP8 requires eight available authorized GPUs. Do not assume four-card training fits.
validation_and_launch.current_action: Implementation complete; 40 CPU tests, real Harbor scripted-generation integration and launch-command comparison passed. 9B/SP8 and full warmup-resume acceptance pending. No formal training launched.

confidence: A single evidence-informed engineering choice, not proven performance improvement.
